11211-a-minstrel-in-france.title: A Minstrel In France
11211-a-minstrel-in-france.creator: Harry Lauder
11211-a-minstrel-in-france.description: A book by Harry Lauder. Yon palmy, peaceful days! I go back to them, and they are as a dream. I go back to them again and again, and live them over. Yon days of another age, the age of peace, when no man dared even to dream of such times as have come upon us.

3257-new-thought-pastels.creator: Unknown
3257-new-thought-pastels.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Go dig, and prune, and guide, and wait,  Until it learns its high estate,  And glorifies some bower. A weed is but an unloved flower! All sin is virtue unevolved,  Release the angel from the clod—  Go love thy brother up to God. Behold each problem solved. All sin is virtue unevolved. Not he who puts to test  His sinews with the strong and proves the best;  But he who dwells where weaklings congregate,  And never lets his splendid strength abate.

The discovery made a great stir amongst the islands, and particularly at St. In the square space before the Customs' House, on the little stone jetty, among the paths through the gorse of the Garrison, it became the staple subject of gossip, until another ship came ashore and other lives were lost. arxiv-1501-00505.description: Abstract In experimental robotics, researchers may face uncertainties in parameters of a robot manipulator that they are working with. This uncertainty may be caused by deviations in the manufacturing process of a manipulator, or changes applied to manipulator in the lab for sake of experiments.

arxiv-2102-08222.title: A new exact solution of black-strings-like with a dS core
arxiv-2102-08222.creator: Milko Estrada
arxiv-2102-08222.description: Abstract We provide a new five dimensional black string–like solution by means of the embedding of a four dimensional regular black hole into a compact extra dimension. We enunciate a list of constraints in order to that the five dimensional black string–like solution to be regular, and, following these constraints we construct our solution.

arxiv-2207-11929.title: Good Locally Testable Codes
arxiv-2207-11929.creator: Irit Dinur, Shai Evra, Ron Livne, Alexander Lubotzky, Shahar Mozes
arxiv-2207-11929.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Irit Dinur, Shai Evra, Ron Livne, Alexander Lubotzky, Shahar Mozes. An explicit construction of locally testable codes of constant rate, constant distance and constant number of queries is given. Hence answering affirmatively the c 3 c^{3} -problem. 1 Introduction An [n,k,d] binary linear error correcting code is a subspace C of \mathbb{F}_{2}^{n} , of dimension k=\dim C , and distance d=\min\{\mbox{wt}(c)\,:\,0\neq c\in C\} , where \mbox{wt}(c)=|\{1\leq i\leq n\,|\,c_{i}\neq 0\}| is the Hamming weight.

arxiv-2209-11651.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Salwa Faour, Mohsen Ghaffari, Christoph Grunau, Fabian Kuhn, Václav Rozhoň. arxiv-2308-16720.title: Dynamical low-rank tensor approximations to high-dimensional parabolic problems: existence and convergence of spatial discretizations
arxiv-2308-16720.creator: Markus Bachmayr 1, Henrik Eisenmann 1, André Uschmajew 2
arxiv-2308-16720.description: Abstract . We consider dynamical low-rank approximations to parabolic problems on higher-order tensor manifolds in Hilbert spaces. In addition to existence of solutions and their stability with respect to perturbations to the problem data, we show convergence of spatial discretizations. Our framework accommodates various standard low-rank tensor formats for multivariate functions, including tensor train and hierarchical tensors.

arxiv-2401-12919.title: Inertial Sensors for Human Motion Analysis: A Comprehensive Review
arxiv-2401-12919.creator: Sara García-de-Villa, David Casillas-Pérez, Ana Jiménez-Martín, Juan Jesús García-Domínguez
arxiv-2401-12919.description: Abstract Inertial motion analysis is having a growing interest during the last decades due to its advantages over classical optical systems. The technological solution based on inertial measurement units allows the measurement of movements in daily living environments, such as in everyday life, which is key for a realistic assessment and understanding of movements.

arxiv-2405-07751.title: Integrating Unsupervised and Supervised learning approaches to unveil Critical Process Inputs
arxiv-2405-07751.creator: Paris Papavasileiou, Dimitrios G. Giovanis, Martin Kathrein, Gabriele Pozzetti, Christoph Czettl, Ioannis G. Kevrekidis, Andreas G. Boudouvis, Stéphane P.A. Bordas, Eleni D. Koronaki
arxiv-2405-07751.description: Abstract This study introduces a machine learning framework tailored to large-scale industrial processes characterized by a plethora of numerical and categorical inputs. The framework aims to (i) discern critical parameters influencing the output and (ii) generate accurate out-of-sample qualitative and quantitative predictions of production outcomes.

arxiv-2410-20848.title: Deep Insights into Automated Optimization with Large Language Models and Evolutionary Algorithms
arxiv-2410-20848.creator: He Yu, Jing Liu
arxiv-2410-20848.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by He Yu, Jing Liu. Designing optimization approaches, no matter heuristic or meta-heuristic, often require extensive manual intervention and struggle to generalize across diverse problem domains. The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) presents a promising new way to overcome these limitations to make optimization more automated, where LLMs function as dynamic agents capable of generating, refining, and interpreting optimization strategies, while EAs explore complex solution spaces efficiently through evolutionary operators.

arxiv-2507-11856.title: Suppression of charge-density wave and superconductivity in a lithiated NbSe 2 monolayer
arxiv-2507-11856.creator: Hari Paudyal, Michael E. Flatté
arxiv-2507-11856.description: Abstract We present an ab initio investigation of the long-range charge density wave (CDW) order and superconducting properties of the pristine and lithiated NbSe 2 monolayer. Stable CDW structures are obtained through atomic reconstruction driven by soft-mode distortions and lithiation, respectively, lead to significant electronic modifications that suppress the CDW order.

pmc-11727583.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this study, we triggered the similar Warburg effect of cancer cells in yeast strains by introducing the human hypoxia-inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) complex, which regulated the expression of numerous enzymes involved in CCM and redirected the metabolic flux from glycolysis to tricarboxylic acid cycle.
